description: Get data extraction statistics showing the scale and health of rate data collection. Use this to understand extraction volumes, product coverage, and data freshness. Supports filtering by date range and product type. Great for building transparency dashboards or monitoring data collection health.

endTime.description: End of the time range. Supports ISO8601 or relative times. Defaults to "now".

product_type.description: Filter statistics to a specific product type. If omitted, returns stats for all product types.

startTime.description: Start of the time range. Supports ISO8601 (e.g., "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z") or relative times ("now-24h", "now-7d", "now-1m"). Defaults to "now-24h".

name: get_extraction_stats

outputSchema.description: Rate-extraction activity for a time window. The handler reshapes /v1/stats: the headline counts are returned as locale-formatted STRINGS, not numbers.

activeInstitutions.description: Institutions active in the window, comma-formatted string.

dataQuality.description: Data-health indicators, passed through unchanged from /v1/stats.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 time the stats were computed.

hourlyTrendSample.description: First six hourly buckets of the trend series (a sample, not the full series).

query.description: The resolved time window and filters the stats were computed over.

stats.description: Headline counters. Note the string formatting.

hoursInRange.description: Length of the window in hours.

totalRates.description: Rates extracted in the window, comma-formatted (e.g. '104,522').

summary.description: One-line headline of rates extracted, per-hour throughput, and institution count.

topProducts.description: Pre-rendered 'name: count (pct%)' string for the three largest product types.
